name: Hawaii
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. The main Hawaiian Islands only, Niihau to the Big Island: Niihau sets the west edge (-160.26), Ka Lae on the Big Island the south edge (18.90), Cape Kumukahi the east edge (-154.80) and Kauai the north edge (22.24). The Northwestern Hawaiian Islands (Papahanaumokuakea, out to Kure Atoll) are left out: they would stretch the box ~1,900 km across open Pacific. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-hi.
